attack_techniques: Disable or Modify Tools: Disable or Modify Cloud Log (T1685.002)
attackers_goals: An attacker may change the configuration of the affected resource to remain undetected.
description: An AWS CloudWatch log stream was deleted, this action permanently deletes all the archives associated with this stream.
investigative_actions: Check why the identity deleted the log stream. Check which resource is affected by this change.
name: AWS CloudWatch log stream deletion
